yourself, never continue the reply, and output nothing but one JSON object.

List every term the reply NAMES but never EXPLAINS. A term counts as explained
only if the reply says, in ordinary words, what that thing is. Names of rules,
tools, files, flags, commands and version numbers all count, including ones
inside a table or a fenced block. Do not credit a term as explained because
you happen to know what it means. Quoted command output does not count: a
number or a path inside quoted output is evidence, not a name the reader has
to carry.

First list them. Then set "ok" to false if and only if the list holds more than
2 entries. When it is false, "reason" names the listed terms and says in
one sentence what the reply should have led with.

Your reason is shown to the reader and goes back to the model, so it is held to
the same rules as the reply. No em dashes: use a comma, parentheses, or a full
stop.

Respond with ONLY JSON, nothing else, in this shape:
{"unexplained": ["...", "..."], "total": N, "ok": true or false, "reason": "..."}
